arc.native_usage: Offline oracle body cache only; shared header; no training.

hellaswag.native_usage: Offline oracle body cache only; shared header; no training.

hotpotqa.native_usage: Offline oracle body cache only; shared header; no training.

config.name: wrongdonor_probe_acd_seed1234
config.question: Is 'no accuracy change when layers 1-18 are replaced by same-prompt native KV' caused by those layers being irrelevant, or by the translated KV there already being accurate?
config.design: For each of 6 layer groups: translated (no injection), same-prompt native KV, and different-question (donor) native KV. Native KV from another question carries wrong content in the same shape and position grid.

decision_rule.content_critical_translation_accurate: group g shows donor well below translated while same-prompt native is within noise of translated
decision_rule.layers_irrelevant: group g shows donor within noise of translated
decision_rule.translation_inaccurate: group g shows same-prompt native well above translated while donor is not above translated
decision_rule.note: Descriptive 2x3 readout frozen before inference; no thresholds tuned after seeing results. n=128 for ARC, 64 for HellaSwag and HotpotQA; 1 question = 0.78pp (ARC) / 1.56pp (others).

caveats: Donor KV is same-prompt-format native KV from a DIFFERENT question of the same task, chosen by closest body token length with a deterministic id tiebreak; HotpotQA additionally requires a different question string. It carries the wrong content on the same positional grid, resampled nearest-neighbour to the target body length.
All injections replace body K and V only, after cache assembly, in post-k_norm/post-RoPE coordinates; the shared public header and all other layers stay untouched. No re-normalization or re-ROPE.
Native KV is offline oracle information. Neither the same-prompt nor the donor arm is deployable; they are controls that separate layer relevance from translation accuracy.

HellaSwag and HotpotQA rows are exactly the first 64 in immutable parent order, matching the reused 64-question anchors; ARC extends the same order to 128. The ARC first-64 subset is reported separately so it can be checked against the 64-question experiments.

The reused unmasked and same-prompt-native (g*_kv) results are identity-checked against the oracle manifest and never recomputed for HellaSwag/HotpotQA; ARC is recomputed in full because it extends to 128 questions.
Donor caches are recomputed per row and discarded; no KV is persisted to disk. Only per-config scores, per-sample records and aggregate distance statistics are kept.
Greedy decoding and fixed prompts; no task is used for tuning. Non-monotonicity and group non-additivity are expected and reportable.
Per-group K/V relative distances to the same-prompt native are recorded as a zero-cost side measurement; they are descriptive only and do not by themselves establish a mechanism.
No GSM8K, no Reader, no training. Pipeline fails on error, preserves per-configuration results, runs detached, no automatic upload or monitoring.
